name: ZCA_IMPORT_PROGRESS
description: The table will hold the status of the progress of the import jobs. The table stores the information like the time taken to complete each step, total steps that would be executed during the import activity and also the current step of execution during the import activity.

columns.name: ZCA_IMPORT_PROGRESS_ID
columns.description: Primary key

columns.name: PARENT_PROGRESS_ID
columns.description: This is used to store parent progress id information.

columns.name: TRACKING_ID
columns.description: This is used to store Tracking id information.

columns.name: PARENT_TRACKING_ID
columns.description: This is used to store Parent Tracking id information.

columns.name: IMPORT_JOB_ID
columns.description: FK to parent import job systask, MKT_IMP_JOBS

columns.name: SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: FK to parent import job systask, MKT_CM_SYSTASKS

columns.name: STEP_NAME
columns.description: Name of the step which is being tracked

columns.name: STEP_STATUS
columns.description: Current status of the step, updated as the import job progresses

columns.name: TRACKING_STEP
columns.description: To store name of the step which is being tracked

columns.name: TRACKING_STEP_STATUS
columns.description: To store status of the step which is being tracked

columns.name: THREAD_NUMBER
columns.description: To store thread number information of the particular  thread

columns.name: THREAD_RECORDS
columns.description: To store thread record information of the particular  thread

columns.name: COMMIT_SIZE
columns.description: To store commit size information for the tracking step

columns.name: PROCESS_TIME
columns.description: To indicate the process time of current tracking step

columns.name: TOTAL_MEMORY_STATE
columns.description: To indicate the memory state of the process involved

columns.name: CLEANUP_COUNTER
columns.description: To store cleanup counter value for the tracking step

columns.name: ECID
columns.description: This field is used to store Ecid information

columns.name: ERROR_DETAILS
columns.description: This field is used to store detailed error message

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: This field is used to store ESS request identifier

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Start time of the current step

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: End time of the current step

columns.name: TIME_TAKEN
columns.description: Total time taken by the current step (in milliseconds), i.e. END_TIME - START_TIME

columns.name: ESTIMATED_TIME
columns.description: Total estimated time which might be taken for completion of the current step (in milliseconds)

columns.name: TOTAL_RECORDS
columns.description: Total number of records processed by the current step

columns.name: ERROR_RECORDS
columns.description: Number of records which errored out during processing of the current step

columns.name: SUCCESS_RECORDS
columns.description: Number of records successfully processed by the current step

columns.name: WARNING_RECORDS
columns.description: Number of records processed with warning by the current step

columns.name: TOTAL_SUBSTEPS
columns.description: Total number of sub-steps that would be executed in the current step

columns.name: CURRENT_SUBSTEP
columns.description: Current sub-step that is being executed in the step, this would be continously updated as the step progresses

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
